words.def: while dealing with stress, tight deadlines or a heavy workload.
words.book: Additionally, my ___ has given me the ability to think strategically, solve problems effectively and work well under pressure, all of which I believe are essential for success in this role.
uses: The team worked well under pressure to restore power at the bank's data centre overnight.
we're under a lot of pressure this week with the tender 😮‍💨
I stay calm under pressure, especially during emergency call-outs.
dont: I can work in the pressure.

words.def: the process of installing and putting a system into use.
words.book: I was responsible for leading a team of ten employees and coordinating with other departments to ensure the successful deployment of the system.
uses: The deployment of the new monitoring software is scheduled for the weekend to avoid downtime.
deployment done ✅ all racks reporting to the dashboard
Let's plan the server deployment in two phases.
dont: We finished putting the system and working it.
doo: We completed the deployment of the system.

words.def: to start using a plan, system or idea and make it work.
words.book: For example, I have experience in ___, and I believe implementing ___ could help the team achieve better results.
uses: We plan to implement a new ticketing system for service requests next quarter.
when are we implementing the new price list?
If we implement remote monitoring, we can cut site visits by 30%.
dont: We will make the new system work in the company.
doo: We will implement the new system.

words.def: to change and improve something so it looks or works better.
words.book: Recently, I was part of a team assigned to revamp the company's internal communications system.
uses: We are revamping our maintenance contract packages and will share the new offer soon.
It's time to revamp our quotation template — it looks outdated.
dont: We will make the system new again.

words.def: to make a process simpler and more efficient by removing unnecessary steps.
words.book: I have experience using agile methodologies to develop mobile apps, and I know they can help streamline the development process and improve the quality of the final product.
uses: We have streamlined the ordering process, so quotations now go out within 24 hours.
can we streamline the approval chain? 5 signatures is too many
Our goal is to streamline purchasing and cut lead times.
dont: We will make the process more easy and fast.

words.def: to make things happen and achieve clear, measurable outcomes.
words.book: This accomplishment demonstrates my ability to lead and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
uses: Our new service team leader has a clear focus on driving results in customer retention.
she really drives results — renewals up 20% 🚀
We need a plan that drives results, not just more meetings.

upgrade.plain: My experience is suitable very much with this job.
pro: My experience is suitable very much for this job.
My experience and skills align very well with this role.
My experience fits with the job very much.
upgrade.why: ‎align very well with‎ أحسن، و‎very much‎ مكانها مش في النص.

upgrade.plain: I have history of good results.
pro: I have a proven track record of delivering results.
I have a history of good results.
I have many good results before.

upgrade.plain: We finished the project in the time and less than the budget.
upgrade.ar: خلّصنا المشروع في ميعاده وبأقل من الميزانية
pro: We finished the project in time and less than budget.
The project finished on the time with less money.
The project was completed on time and under budget.
upgrade.why: الجملة الثابتة ‎on time and under budget‎.

upgrade.plain: We made the sales more than the target by 20%.
upgrade.ar: عملنا مبيعات أكتر من التارجت بـ ٢٠٪
pro: We made more sales from the target 20%.

upgrade.plain: I have new ideas can help the team.
upgrade.ar: عندي أفكار جديدة ممكن تساعد الفريق
pro: I have new ideas can help the team.
I have a few ideas I believe could benefit the team.
I have some new ideas for help the team.
upgrade.why: محتاج فعل واضح: ‎ideas that could benefit the team‎.

upgrade.plain: The most thing I am proud of it is the UPS project.
upgrade.ar: أكتر حاجة فخور بيها مشروع الـ UPS
pro: The thing I am most proud of it is the UPS project.
The most thing I'm proud is the UPS project.
One accomplishment that stands out is the UPS roll-out for a major bank.
upgrade.why: في الإنجليزي مفيش ‎it‎ زيادة بعد ‎of‎، و‎stands out‎ أشيك.
